avis.titre: A Staple in My Skincare Routine – Especially for Travel & Dry Skin!
avis.texte: This face cream has truly earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine. The texture is soft and velvety with absolutely no scent, which I really appreciate—especially since my skin can be sensitive. It dispenses easily, and the consistency is just right: not too greasy or heavy, but also not too light. It strikes that perfect balance and soaks in beautifully. One of my favorite things is how well it layers under makeup. It creates a smooth base without pilling or feeling slick, and it works just as well at night as it does during the day. I travel constantly—including ultra-long 23-hour flights from LAX to Hong Kong—and this cream always comes with me in my carry-on. Airplane cabins are incredibly drying, and applying this mid-flight makes a noticeable difference in keeping my skin hydrated and comfortable. I’ve also been in a cold climate for the past three months, and this has significantly helped with my dry skin. For reference, I’m over 50 with dry, menopausal skin, and my dermatologist actually recommended this for my rosacea. I’ve seen a substantial improvement in redness and overall skin comfort since using it consistently. It’s gentle, effective, and reliable. I will absolutely continue using this as a routine staple and highly recommend it—especially if you travel often, live in a dry climate, or struggle with sensitive or mature skin.

avis.titre: Lightweight and gentle, but not quite hydrating enough for dry patches
avis.texte: I’ve been using this face lotion for a little while now, and overall I really do like it. The texture is super lightweight and absorbs quickly, which is a huge plus for me. It doesn’t feel greasy at all, and most important it hasn’t caused any breakouts. My skin can be sensitive, so finding something that doesn’t clog pores is always a win. That said, I do still notice dryness in certain spots, especially around my nose and cheeks. The lotion feels great when it first goes on, but the hydration doesn’t always last throughout the day. I’ve tried layering a bit more for extra moisture, but when I apply too much, it tends to get cakey and doesn’t sit well under makeup. Overall, it’s a solid daily moisturizer if you want something light and gentle, but if you have dry patches or need deeper hydration, you might need to pair it with a heavier cream or serum. I’ll keep using it, but it’s not quite a one-and-done solution for dryness.

The problem is, many of those products tend to be drying, so I needed something that could restore hydration without clogging my pores or causing new breakouts. This moisturizer has been exactly what I needed. It provides lightweight but effective hydration, feels great on the skin, and hasn’t triggered any irritation or breakouts. I’ve made it a regular part of my nighttime routine. During the day, I use the Double Repair Matte Moisturizer with SPF 30 (the blue bottle), which I also love for its sun protection and matte finish. But for night, I prefer this one since it’s more hydrating and doesn’t contain SPF. Another bonus: the bottle is a generous size, but still compact enough to travel with, which is perfect for someone like me who’s often on the go. If you have acne-prone skin and need a non-comedogenic, hydrating moisturizer, this is a great option — especially as part of a day/night skincare combo.

You could also just use it as a dedicated nighttime moisturizer if you don't want to risk someone seeing you pill at all. It'd be perfect for someone with an oily, sensitive skin type and they would not have much issue like I did. They both came in open, and with an incredible difference, one is filled up about 60% of the bottle while the other one is about 35-40% all the way. The product itself is good, but this quality control problem is unbelievable, Not a good value for money, product size portions are extremely skewed against the customer side.

avis.titre: White flakes all over my face
avis.texte: I’m returning this moisturizer. I was so embarrassed at work when my coworkers told me I have something on my face. I ran to the bathroom and saw this!!!
When I put this on it flakes off it is very strange. Not a fan of it at all. Will not buy again.
The box arrived smashed and the moisturizer was unsealed - without any metallic protection on the tube. Pretty disappointing...
